name: qeli-web-assets
description: Build pipeline for the qeli web panel's self-hosted CSS (no runtime CDN). Generated app.css is committed under ../src/web/assets/ and embedded into the binary; this package is only needed to regenerate it.
//overrides: postcss arrives transitively through tailwindcss, which still accepts the vulnerable range, so it cannot be raised by bumping tailwind. Pinned here rather than added to devDependencies: it is not something this package uses directly, and declaring it as a dependency would misstate what this build needs. GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (path traversal via sourceMappingURL) does not reach us — postcss only ever parses our own input.css at build time, never untrusted CSS — but a transitive dev package is cheap to keep current.
